description: FirstCommit '26 – CampusCode's Inaugural Hackathon FirstCommit '26 is the first hackathon hosted on CampusCode, a student-built platform dedicated exclusively to hackathons. This is a 24-hour, fully online hackathon open to college students across India. How to Participate: Join the official WhatsApp Channel for announcements: https://chat.whatsapp.com/GvG0CuwqKwM1v1rfZ7kgQP?s=cl&p=a&mlu=4&ilr=4 Register your team on CampusCode at campuscode.co.in. The registration link will be shared on the WhatsApp Channel first. Build your solution, submit it round by round, and present it to the judges. Tracks: Build for Campus: Solve real problems related to college life. AI in Action: Build AI agents, automation tools, or LLM-based applications. Open Innovation: Create any bold and innovative solution. Team Size: 1–4 members. Inter-college teams are allowed. Eligibility: College students across India. Entry Fee: Completely free. Prizes and Rewards: ₹3,000 prize pool for the top three teams. Certificates for every participant. Winners will be featured on CampusCode's LinkedIn. Format: 24 hours, comprising three rounds: Round 1: Idea submission. Round 2: Build and submit. Round 3: Final review by judges. Dates: 14–15 November 2026 (tentative). Final dates will be announced on the official WhatsApp Channel. Build something real. Be part of the first commit.

  • ₹3,000 prize pool for the top three teams.

  • Certificates for every participant.

Winners will be featured on CampusCode's LinkedIn.

Format: 24 hours, comprising three rounds:

  • Round 1: Idea submission.

  • Round 2: Build and submit.

  • Round 3: Final review by judges. Dates: 14–15 November 2026 (tentative). Final dates will be announced on the official WhatsApp Channel.

Build something real. Be part of the first commit.
